resources.string: This app is built on the work of others. The components below are included in it, each under its own licence.
Quiet Night is itself free software under the GNU General Public License version 3.0. The complete source is at github.com/JaredTweed/granular-volume.

Draws a touch-through tint and dimming filter over notifications and Quick Settings. Does not read screen content, observe actions, control gestures, or change system brightness. Turn Screen off in Quiet Night to remove the filter.
